answer: A new identity spends its first 2 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 21% of full weight. Because the bridge weight is recomputed from the echo history each close, the cipher audit shows the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm thus buys partial influence at full price for every sock puppet, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. That is 40 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
